Date: 2022-08-02
IN THE ABSTRACT:
Please replace the Abstract with the following:
Monitoring driving safety information before a vehicle enters a curve or when the vehicle has entered the curve; obtaining a position of the vehicle in response to the driving safety information; obtaining curve information, where the curve information includes at least one of a position of a start point of the curve and a position of an end point of the curve; and controlling, based on the position of the vehicle and the curve information, the vehicle to stop at a position outside the curve.
